Preserves all measurements and comparison conditions. “Higher observed mAP and slower inference” clearly states the trade-off, and “the baseline received half as many training updates” identifies the attribution problem. The ablation is accurately distinguished from proof of mechanism.

Provides a coherent result-led paragraph retaining all numerical and design details. “Limiting attribution of the accuracy difference to the method itself” correctly handles unequal training, and “variability remains unquantified” appropriately describes the absence of repeated seeds.

reviews.rationale: Interprets rescue as supporting a “functional contribution” within L, explicitly acknowledges M and its missing rescue data, and separates functional evidence from binding or pathway identification. The proposed matched-depletion experiment tests a plausible explanation without inventing completed work.

Synthesizes perturbation and rescue with the uncertain M response while preserving the molecular-mechanism boundary. The proposed test has especially clear interpretive branches: “a persistent difference” supports context dependence, whereas “convergence under matched perturbation” favors unequal perturbation effectiveness.

reviews.rationale: Preserves the marker, time, fold-change, and culture-level interval. “Biological n = 3” and “six well readings were nested within cultures” correctly repair pseudoreplication. The separate note explains the substantive corrections, and the mechanism and cell-type claims remain bounded.

Accurately reports the culture-level estimate and distinguishes “technical measurements” from independent biological replicates. The prose directly identifies drug T and clearly states that binding was untested. The brief note adequately explains both replication and interpretation corrections.

Correctly explains that the sensitivity analysis “削弱了主要估计的稳健性” and avoids treating either interval as proof of ineffectiveness or benefit. However, the prose falls below the requested 180 Chinese characters when counting Han characters rather than numerals, Latin letters, and punctuation.

reviews.rationale: Integrates the primary estimate, uncertainty, and attenuation after excluding early events. “事件发生时间可能影响估计，但不能单凭该分析确定原因” provides a plausible, explicitly tentative interpretation. The conclusion accurately characterizes an uncertain association sensitive to analytic conditions, and the Chinese-character length meets the request.

Uses exactly two sentences and preserves all performance estimates, the retrospective single-hospital setting, and untested calibration. “Discrimination within the internal test sample” states the substantive finding, while the conclusion specifically separates transportability and patient outcomes from internal predictive performance.

Meets the two-sentence and word-count requirements while retaining every supplied performance estimate. “No prospective study, external cohort, or treatment-impact analysis” identifies concrete validation gaps and appropriately blocks prevention and bedside-readiness claims.

Clearly distinguishes idealized predictions, the resistance-inclusive prediction, and the single prototype measurement. “Close to the resistance-inclusive prediction” is a defensible descriptive comparison without claiming that resistance explains the entire mismatch. The opening design question gives the abstract direction, although “leaving the comparison ... unresolved” is repeated in the ending.
reviews.suggested_repair: Remove the repeated unresolved-comparison wording and use the final sentence to emphasize the bounded design contribution.

reviews.rationale: Builds a coherent model-to-prototype argument while preserving 12/10/9 W as predictions and 8.7 W as a measurement. “The adjusted predictions do not establish a comparative advantage” correctly handles the unmatched resistance condition. The ending supports explicit resistance modelling without extrapolating beyond 300 K.
